system.text:
Pinkies are a bit “off” in their thinking and tend to be socially awkward. People who speak to one often come away dazed by a bombardment of trivia, non sequiturs and bad jokes. During a Duel of Wits, this trait grants the character +3D to Incite. The only hesitation option is to “Stand and Blink.” All attempts to Intimidate or Command a character with Confusing Rant are at +2 Ob. Also, Ranters are at a +2 Ob to all Oratory and Rhetoric tests.

Type: Dt. Cost: 9 pts.

Source: Burning Wheel Codex, p. 515
